SEN.note: The communique concerns tax administration and states nothing on police.

facts.fact: The DGID's communique of 27 August 2026 says the SENTAX platform replaces ETAX for online payment (telepaiement) of taxes by Large Enterprises Directorate taxpayers.
The DGID says SENTAX now replaces ETAX for online filing of returns by Large Enterprises Directorate taxpayers.
The DGID says SENTAX lets Large Enterprises Directorate taxpayers pay taxes online (telepaiement).

The DGID says use of SENTAX becomes mandatory for all declarations and payments of Large Enterprises Directorate taxpayers from 1 September 2026, and paper returns are no longer accepted by that directorate.

systems.owner: Direction generale des Impots et des Domaines

SEN.note: The communique names no taxpayer register or taxpayer number.
